Don't run more sessions than your statistical plan requires. With 5 variants × 10 seeds = 50 sessions, you have a reasonable study. Don't run 500 just because you can.

features.quote: Variant E (gaslighting) is the most aggressive design. Consider whether it's necessary or whether Variants A-D answer your primary questions. If you run it, keep it to the minimum seed count needed.
